name: TimeBucks
description: GPT site with a strong 'watch videos/slides' earn route plus surveys, offerwalls, tasks, referrals. Official minimum payout $3 (some sources cite $10 — verify); paid out Sun–Thu via PayPal/gift cards/crypto. Low hourly rate but very low threshold.

quickFacts.value: Weekly — Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu (server time)

Some sources cite a higher $10 threshold — verify
reviewData.reviewBody:
TimeBucks is a GPT site best known for its watch-videos/slideshows earn route (slides auto-advance, so it can run semi-passively), plus surveys, offerwalls, tasks and a strong referral program. Its official help center states a $3 minimum payout — one of the lowest in GPT — with payments sent weekly (Sun–Thu server time) via PayPal, gift cards, crypto or direct deposit. Some third-party sources cite a $10 threshold, so verify in your account.

Hourly pay is very low (videos/slides pay pennies), and offerwall screen-outs are common. But the $3 minimum and weekly payouts make it one of the fastest GPTs to actually reach cashout — good for beginners wanting quick proof of payment. Pair with higher-paying panels for rate.
reviewData.testNotes: $3 official minimum and Sun–Thu weekly payout verified 25 Sep 2026 against TimeBucks' official help center (updated Jul 2026); third-party $10 discrepancy flagged. No live account test performed.

reviewData.reviewBody:
HideoutTV is a watch-videos-to-earn platform: videos autoplay (can run passively in the background) and you earn points, redeemable to partner reward sites (Swagbucks, InboxDollars, RewardXP and others) or direct gift cards — there's typically no direct PayPal. It's reliable (trust 72) but earnings are very low, often cents per day, and the site is ads-heavy.

Best used as a truly passive earner (run it muted in a tab) and redeem into a partner site you already use. Don't expect meaningful income; it's pocket change for otherwise-idle screen time.
reviewData.testNotes: Partner-redemption model and passive autoplay verified 25 Sep 2026 against HideoutTV and 2026 watch-video comparisons. No direct PayPal confirmed. No live account test performed.

reviewData.reviewBody:
Lootup is a GPT site from the same operator as GrabPoints: watch videos, surveys, offerwalls and paid emails, with a typical ~$5 minimum via PayPal or gift cards. It's mid-tier reliable (trust 68).

Video earnings are very low (cents), offerwall screen-outs are common, and the ~$5 minimum is higher than TimeBucks' $3. A solid supplementary GPT — especially if you already use GrabPoints — but not a primary earner. Verify the exact minimum in your account.

reviewData.reviewBody:
Nielsen Computer & Mobile Panel is the classic passive earner: install the app, keep it running, and it collects anonymous usage data in exchange for points and sweepstakes entries — typically ~$50/year in value, paid as gift cards (usually no cash). Zero effort after install, and Nielsen is a reputable major research firm.

It's marked under_review because panel availability varies by country and several national Nielsen panels have closed or been restructured — verify it's open in your country before installing. Earnings are very low (~$50/year), and it shares anonymous usage data (read the privacy policy). Best as set-and-forget pocket change, never as income.

name: InboxDollars
description: Long-established GPT (Prodege) — paid emails, watch videos, surveys, offers, cashback. $5 sign-up bonus. Payout minimum has a documented discrepancy: Help Center says $15 first cashout / $10 subsequent; Terms of Use cite $30. PayPal/gift cards/check. US-focused.

reviewData.reviewBody:
InboxDollars is the long-established Prodege GPT: paid emails, watch videos, surveys, offers and cashback, with a $5 sign-up bonus. It's reliable and US-focused (the UK variant is InboxPounds, £20 minimum). Its main downside is a high payout minimum — and there's a documented discrepancy: the Help Center says $15 for the first cashout / $10 thereafter, while the Terms of Use cite $30. Verify the exact threshold in your account before relying on it.

High-value offers (spend-based) can reach the threshold quickly, but pure video/survey earnings are slow at that minimum. For faster cashout, TimeBucks ($3) or Survey Junkie ($5) pay out far sooner. Payouts via PayPal, gift cards or check.

reviewData.reviewBody:
PrizeRebel (since 2007) is one of the longest-running, most trusted GPTs — it also appears in the surveys category; it's listed here because it offers a watch-videos earn route alongside surveys, offerwalls and tasks. Points are worth $0.01; payouts from ~$5 via PayPal, 500+ gift cards, crypto or direct bank, fast (instant at Gold+ loyalty levels).

Video earnings are very low (cents), and the best perks require grinding to Gold+. Use for volume and reliability; the video route specifically is weaker than TimeBucks/HideoutTV. (Same platform as the surveys-category entry — not a duplicate across categories.)

name: GrabPoints
description: GPT site (sister to Lootup) — watch videos, surveys, offerwalls, downloads. Low minimum (~$2–3 for gift cards; PayPal typically ~$5). Points (1,000 = $1). Fast payouts. Mid-tier reliable.

quickFacts.label: Earn routes
quickFacts.value: Watch videos, surveys, offerwalls, app downloads

reviewData.reviewBody:
GrabPoints is a GPT site (same operator as Lootup): watch videos, surveys, offerwalls and app downloads, with points worth $1 per 1,000. It has one of the lowest gift-card minimums (~$2–3; PayPal typically ~$5) and fast payout processing. Mid-tier reliable (trust 70).

Video earnings are very low and offerwall screen-outs are common. The low gift-card minimum makes it fast to cash out — good for beginners — but for pure video earning, TimeBucks ($3, weekly) and HideoutTV (passive) are comparable. Verify exact PayPal minimum in your account.
reviewData.testNotes: ~$2–3 gift-card / ~$5 PayPal minimum and same-operator-as-Lootup verified 25 Sep 2026 against GrabPoints and 2026 GPT comparisons. No live account test performed.
